records.title: Digitize facilities inspection checklist
records.currentStateEvidence: A four-week sample found 31 of 96 paper checklists required follow-up for missing fields.
records.targetOutcome: Reduce incomplete inspection submissions from 32% to below 10% within eight weeks of launch.

riskReduction.source: Facilities risk review dated 2026-07-15 links missing checklist fields to delayed corrective action.

strategicAlignment.source: Approved annual operations plan objective OPS-4 calls for consistent inspection evidence.

timeCriticality.source: The annual inspection cycle begins 2026-10-01; the requested quarter would support that cycle without claiming a fixed compliance deadline.

records.title: Send automated appointment reminders
records.currentStateEvidence: Staff report frequent no-shows; no approved baseline or sampling period is attached.

records.title: Refresh executive performance dashboard
records.currentStateEvidence: Three departments currently publish different values for two similarly named service metrics.
records.targetOutcome: Publish one executive dashboard before the October council meeting.
records.specialRequest: Defer the accepted service-locator accessibility remediation and let the sponsor participate in approval so this work can start immediately.
